outcomes.reason: The EGR drop is observed and a scheduler change preceded it, but no counterfactual or sham is given, so the causal claim is neither established nor falsified. L1 forbids deriving cause silently from observation.

Three same-family LLM verifiers with unanimous agreement are correlated rather than independent, and there is no formal check. Consensus does not grant verification value, and nothing falsifies the proof either.

The sham shows the blur persists when the coating's rendering is identical, and the effect survives removal of the mechanism. Under R1 the coating is not established as necessary for the blur, so the claim is not earned, and it is not shown false either.

C2 supersedes C1 while C1 remains retained, C2 has a non-empty evidence delta, and it carries an independent replay witness. The lineage is preserved, so no erasure occurs and the supersession is witnessed.

A regex over proof text is independent but low-reliability and syntactic-only, so it provides negligible verification value for the theorem. The claim is not earned under R2 and is not shown false.
